text: On a Managed Instance or a VM-hosted SQL Server, sp_add_job would be the natural next step. OverlookClinicalDB is Azure SQL Database, a true PaaS database, and SQL Server Agent doesn't run the way you'd expect there at all. Reaching for the on-prem pattern here is the wrong tool for this specific platform.

Elastic Jobs is Microsoft's purpose-built scheduler for exactly this case. A job agent database holds job definitions and history. A target group defines which databases the job runs against. And a job is simply the T-SQL script plus its schedule.

Scheduling Lesson 10's maintenance script for a weekly job, running Sunday at 2 AM rather than a weekday mid-morning, matters for the exact same reason this chapter started. A rebuild consumes real CPU, I-O, and log throughput — the same resources Billing and Scheduling need during the day.

Creating a job is not the same as confirming it ran successfully. jobs dot job_executions is the real execution-history view, and lifecycle showing Succeeded is the actual proof the schedule is working — the same discipline as re-testing the execution plan back in Lesson 7.

With the maintenance job scheduled and verified, the fix from Lesson 7 and the discipline from Lesson 9 both stay fixed going forward, not just today. Next lesson pulls all of this together into one monitoring query for ongoing visibility.
